title: Mind the KF* Gap: EME Vulnerabilities to Global Shocks
title_zh: 注意KF*缺口：新兴市场经济体对全球冲击的脆弱性
authors: John D. Burger, Francis E. Warnock, Veronica Cacdac Warnock
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Emerging market economies (EMEs) have historically been vulnerable to external shocks. Recently the global economy has experienced several major shocks yet EMEs have been remarkably resilient. Some of this improved performance can be attributed to prudent policies and stronger economic fundamentals, but the existing literature points to an overperformance mystery by some EMEs with weaker fundamentals. We evaluate an alternative measure of vulnerability based on the concept of a natural level of capital flows (KF*). Specifically, we hypothesize that EMEs are more vulnerable when prior to a large global shock capital flows—portfolio inflows, to be specific—exceed KF*. Results indicate that for major global shocks over the past two decades the pre-shock gap between actual portfolio and KF* has substantial predictive power for the post-shock performance of EMEs.
abstract_zh: 新兴市场经济体（EMEs）历来易受外部冲击影响。近年来全球经济经历多次重大冲击，但新兴市场经济体展现出显著韧性。这种表现的改善部分可归因于审慎的政策和更坚实的经济基本面，但现有文献指出，部分基本面较弱的新兴市场经济体存在"表现超常之谜"。我们基于资本流动自然水平（KF*）概念，评估了一种替代性脆弱性指标。具体而言，我们假设当重大全球冲击发生前，资本流动（特别是证券投资流入）超过KF*时，新兴市场经济体将更为脆弱。研究结果表明，过去二十年间的重大全球冲击中，冲击前实际证券投资与KF*之间的缺口，对新兴市场经济体冲击后的表现具有显著预测能力。

title: Trade Sophistication and Economic Development Stages in the Context of Global Digitalization
title_zh: 全球数字化背景下的贸易复杂度与经济发展阶段
authors: Kim Hanh Nguyen, Anna Strutt, Mark J. Holmes, Steven Lim
abstract: This study aims to explore the relationship between trade sophistication and economic development stages, including in the context of digitalization. We employ nonparametric, semiparametric, and parametric methods, covering the period from 2003 to 2024 across 119 countries, categorized into three income groups. Our findings show that GDP per capita has a positive but diminishing relationship with export and import sophistication, suggesting that trade sophistication grows rapidly at lower levels of economic development but slows down as economies become more economically advanced. The evolution patterns of export and import sophistication are relatively similar throughout the stages of economic development; however, the level of export sophistication consistently exceeds that of import sophistication across all income groups. In the context of digital transformation, digitalization is found to positively affect trade sophistication in high and middle‐income countries, while GDP per capita remains positively associated with trade sophistication, but with diminishing marginal effects. For low‐income countries, GDP per capita is the primary driver of increased trade sophistication, while in high‐income countries, digitalization stands out as the dominant factor. These findings remain robust after controlling for human capital, FDI, and institutional quality, highlighting the importance of formulating stage‐specific economic policies to enhance trade sophistication in the rapidly evolving digital era.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本研究旨在探讨贸易复杂度与经济发展阶段之间的关系，并纳入数字化背景进行分析。我们采用非参数、半参数及参数方法，覆盖2003年至2024年间119个国家，并将其划分为三个收入组别。研究结果表明，人均GDP与出口及进口复杂度呈正向但边际递减的关系，即贸易复杂度在经济发展水平较低阶段增长较快，但随着经济体日趋成熟而增速放缓。出口与进口复杂度的演变模式在经济发展各阶段相对相似；然而，在所有收入组别中，出口复杂度水平始终高于进口复杂度。在数字化转型背景下，数字化对高收入及中等收入国家的贸易复杂度具有正向影响，而人均GDP仍与贸易复杂度保持正向关联，但边际效应递减。对于低收入国家，人均GDP是提升贸易复杂度的主要驱动力；而在高收入国家，数字化则成为主导因素。在控制人力资本、外商直接投资及制度质量后，上述结论依然稳健，凸显了在快速演变的数字时代制定分阶段经济政策以提升贸易复杂度的重要性。

title: Uncovering the choreography of life: the impact of life transitions on gendered housework patterns
title_zh: 揭示生活编排：生命转折对性别化家务模式的影响
authors: Pia Molitor, Mara Rebaudo, Miriam Rehm
abstract: In this paper, we investigate changes in time allocated to routine housework around four life events – cohabitation, marriage, first birth, and divorce – to explore the influence of social norms on gendered housework patterns. Using data from the German Socio‐Economic Panel (1991–2019), a timing‐based event study design reveals that gender differences intensify with cohabitation and parenthood. Women's housework hours increase significantly with the first child, while men's decrease. Marriage has no additional impact beyond cohabitation, and divorce leads to a rise in men's and a reduction in women's housework. Couples with higher‐earning women and those in East Germany show weaker adherence to these social roles.
abstract_zh: 本文通过考察同居、结婚、生育第一个子女和离婚四个人生事件前后日常家务劳动时间的变化，探究社会规范对性别化家务分工模式的影响。基于德国社会经济面板数据（1991-2019年）的时间事件研究设计显示，性别差异在同居和成为父母后加剧。女性家务劳动时间在生育第一个子女后显著增加，而男性则减少。婚姻对家务时间的影响未超出同居效应，离婚则导致男性家务时间上升、女性家务时间下降。女性收入较高的夫妻以及东德地区的夫妻，对社会角色的遵循程度较弱。

title: Urban Transit Infrastructure and Inequality
title_zh: 城市交通基础设施与不平等
authors: Kwok Hao Lee, Brandon Joel Tan
abstract: We propose a quantitative spatial model featuring heterogeneous worker groups and their travel to consume nontradable goods and services. We consider the opening of the Downtown Line in Singapore, which connected regions where high-income households have residential amenities to where nontraded sectors are productive. Leveraging transit farecard data, we show that high-income workers saw large welfare gains but low-income workers gained little. Everyone enjoyed improved access to consumption opportunities, but low-income jobs in nontradables moved to less attractive workplaces. Abstracting from consumption travel understates the disparate impact across worker groups threefold.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含异质性工人群体及其通勤消费非贸易商品与服务的定量空间模型。以新加坡市区线的开通为研究对象，该线路将高收入家庭享有居住便利性的区域与非贸易部门具有生产优势的区域相连接。基于交通票务数据，我们发现高收入工人获得了显著的福利提升，而低收入工人获益甚微。所有群体均享受到消费机会改善，但非贸易部门的低收入岗位转移至吸引力较低的工作场所。若忽略消费通勤因素，不同工人群体间的差异化影响将被低估三倍。
